description: Bonescythe Legplates Level 60 Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Legplates if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legplates, 20 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar, 8 Cured Rugged Hides and 100 gold pieces. Requirements: - Desecrated Legplates - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 20 - Arcanite Bar - Cured Rugged Hide x 8 - Money: 100
